extracted.intended_audience: nonprofit organizations, community groups, and other prospective grantees seeking funding from the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation (RWJF)
extracted.subtask_description: Overview page for organizations seeking RWJF funding: describes RWJF programmatic priority areas, basic administrative requirements for grantees (reporting and tax-status), and the Foundation's expectation around grantee products and resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual Reporting (Annual Narrative and Annual Financial Reports)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Annual Narrative and Annual Financial Reports are required for multi-year grants only. Both reports are submitted at the end of each reporting period until the last year of the grant, at which time the Final reports are submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit an Annual Narrative and an Annual Financial Report at the end of each reporting period for multi-year grants; submit Final reports in the final year of the grant. (No additional submission details provided on this page; see 'Explore our reporting' for more.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Tax Status determination
rubrics_metrics.description: In making a grant to you, the Foundation needs to determine your organization type and tax exempt status according to the Internal Revenue Code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must provide documentation or information that allows RWJF to determine organization type and IRC tax-exempt status; visit the Tax Status section for specifics and required materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grantee products (expectation to document program-related outputs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Connected with our grant programs, RWJF maintains an extensive database of numerous types of 'grantee products' which capture a broad array of program-related analysis, outreach, and impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grantee-produced materials (analysis, outreach products, impact documentation, etc.) are collected and catalogued by the Foundation; applicants and grantees should expect to produce and share such products as part of program activities and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with RWJF programmatic focus areas
rubrics_metrics.description: RWJF funds work that advances health equity across multiple systems; key program areas listed on this page include Community Development, Economic Inclusion for Families, Government, Health Science Knowledge, Healthcare, Media, and Public Health.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should align with the Foundation's stated priorities and goals for each area (examples on page: Community Development — ensure safe, affordable housing and access to healthy food/clean water/good jobs; Economic Inclusion for Families — reform tax and caregiving systems to support caregivers; Government — foster inclusive, multiracial democracy; Health Science Knowledge — broaden data collection and use including cultural/community knowledge to prioritize equity; Healthcare — affordable/respectful care and diverse workforce; Media — more diverse/less biased storytelling about health; Public Health — trustworthy, accountable public health systems supported by funding, data, and capacity). Alignment with one or more of these areas is implied as a criterion for funding consideration.
